methodology: Within each host: A1,A2 (A/A), A3,B1 (A/B), B2,A4 (B/A). Each launch has 3 warmup trials then 20 samples per path. Pooled comparison uses A3+A4 against B1+B2 (40 samples per path per variant). Delta is B minus A. No concurrent compilation/test/GUI automation; ordinary OS background activity uncontrolled.
limits: DOM condition plus two rAF callbacks is a proxy, not physical display or dropped frames.
Scroll-highlight measures programmatically positioned browser scroll events, not manual-to-follow transition latency.
First samples are first measured warmup trials after fixture setup, not cold launch or lazy-mount latency.
A Web artifact is prior CI dx 0.7.9; B Web artifact is local Windows dx 0.7.10, both release without debug symbols. Same-host result is not an isolated compiler-independent causal attribution.
Memory snapshots have no forced GC. JS heap/DOM counters and Wasm capacity are not live Rust heap; native app private bytes excludes its WebView2 child processes.
No physical display, dropped-frame, layout-cost, Android native, assistive technology, or true touch/inertia performance result.
